description: Scoped permissions for the detached PDF preview window (E11). Read-only: it renders a compiled PDF mirrored from the main window over the event bridge and never writes, opens dialogs, or spawns processes. Its only filesystem need is a binary read of the compiled PDF, so the static scope is PDFs under the default projects root — no text reads, no directory listing, no writes. The app-global fs runtime scope (projects root, seeded in lib.rs) is the floor it cannot go below; custom IPC is gated by both the registered-root registry in project.rs and the main-window label check in ipc_guard.rs.
